# Change request 24 for the notes app

The app in this directory already implements the notes app. Everything it does today must keep working, with and
without JavaScript, unless this request changes it. Change the following.

## Read-only accounts
- The admin can make another user's account read-only, and writable again. The table on `/admin` gets a third
  column with the header cell `Access`; in each row that cell starts with the text `writable` or `read-only`.
  The row of every user other than `admin` also has a button `Make <name> read-only` (for a writable account) or
  `Make <name> writable` (for a read-only one). The `admin` row has neither button.
- Only the admin can change this: the **server** refuses it for anyone else.
- While an account is read-only, its user can still sign in and out, read and search their notes, use `Load more`,
  open note pages, export, and delete their account. The **server** refuses every other change to their notes:
  adding, editing (on the list page and on the note page), deleting, `Delete selected`, `Undo`, pinning,
  archiving, `Archive selected`, restoring, sharing and unsharing. Nothing changes, and the page the user ends up
  on shows `Your account is read-only` in an element with `role="alert"`.
- The list page of a read-only user shows the text `Read-only account`.
- It affects no one else: notes the user shared stay visible to the users they were shared with, and the user still
  sees the notes shared with them.
- The setting is kept on the server and survives signing out and in. Deleting the account ends it: the same name
  signing in again starts writable.
- Making an account read-only or writable also works with JavaScript disabled.

export type Lang = 'en' | 'de'

export const LANG_COOKIE = 'lang'

const de: Record<string, string> = {
  'Sign in': 'Anmelden',
  Name: 'Name',
  'Account deleted': 'Konto gelöscht',
  'Name must be 2–20 letters': 'Der Name muss aus 2–20 Buchstaben bestehen',
  Notes: 'Notizen',
  'Signed in as': 'Angemeldet als',
  'Sign out': 'Abmelden',
  'Notes:': 'Notizen:',
  Title: 'Titel',
  Add: 'Hinzufügen',
  Delete: 'Löschen',
  Search: 'Suche',
  'Search button': 'Suchen',
  'You already have a note with this title': 'Du hast bereits eine Notiz mit diesem Titel',
  Edit: 'Bearbeiten',
  Save: 'Speichern',
  Cancel: 'Abbrechen',
  Pin: 'Anheften',
  Unpin: 'Lösen',
  Archive: 'Archivieren',
  Undo: 'Rückgängig',
  Share: 'Teilen',
  'Archived notes': 'Archivierte Notizen',
  'Delete account': 'Konto löschen',
  'Delete selected': 'Ausgewählte löschen',
  'Archive selected': 'Ausgewählte archivieren',
  'Load more': 'Mehr laden',
  'No notes match': 'Keine passenden Notizen',
  'Shared with me': 'Mit mir geteilt',
}

/** The page language, read from the (HttpOnly) cookie while rendering on the server and kept in state for the client. */
export function useLang() {
  return useState<Lang>('lang', () => {
    if (import.meta.client) return 'en'
    const cookie = useRequestHeaders(['cookie']).cookie ?? ''
    const match = cookie.split(';').map((part) => part.trim()).find((part) => part.startsWith(`${LANG_COOKIE}=`))
    return match?.slice(LANG_COOKIE.length + 1) === 'de' ? 'de' : 'en'
  })
}

/** Translates an English text into the current language; texts without a translation stay in English. */
export function useT() {
  const lang = useLang()
  return (text: string) => (lang.value === 'de' ? de[text] ?? text : text === 'Search button' ? 'Search' : text)
}

1	import { ARCHIVED_ERROR, NOTE_BODY_MAX_LENGTH, NOTE_MAX_LENGTH } from '#shared/types/note'

3	export default defineEventHandler(async (event) => {
4	  const form = isFormPost(event)
5	  const name = currentUser(event)
6	  if (!name) {
7	    if (form) return sendRedirect(event, '/login', 303)
8	    throw createError({ statusCode: 401, statusMessage: 'Not signed in' })
9	  }
10	  const id = getRouterParam(event, 'id') ?? ''
11	  const payload = await readBody<{ title?: unknown; body?: unknown; action?: unknown }>(event)
12	  // The Cancel button submits the same form without JavaScript.
13	  if (form && payload?.action === 'cancel') return sendRedirect(event, '/notes', 303)
14	  const existing = findNote(name, id)
15	  if (!existing) {
16	    if (form) return sendRedirect(event, '/notes', 303)
17	    throw createError({ statusCode: 404, statusMessage: 'Note not found' })
18	  }
19	  if (existing.archived) {
20	    if (form) return sendRedirect(event, '/archive', 303)
21	    throw createError({ statusCode: 409, statusMessage: ARCHIVED_ERROR, data: { code: 'archived' } })
22	  }
23	  const fail = (code: string) => sendRedirect(event, `/notes?edit=${encodeURIComponent(id)}&editError=${code}`, 303)
24	
25	  // The note's own page sends a `body` field (even when empty); the list's inline title-only edit does not.
26	  const hasBody = typeof payload?.body === 'string'
27	  const rawTitle = typeof payload?.title === 'string' ? payload.title : ''
28	  const title = rawTitle.trim()
29	  const rawBody = hasBody ? (payload.body as string) : ''
30	  const bodyText = rawBody.trim()
31	
32	  let titleCode: string | null = null
33	  if (title.length < 1) titleCode = 'invalid'
34	  else if (title.length > NOTE_MAX_LENGTH) titleCode = 'too-long'
35	  else if (noteExists(name, title, id)) titleCode = 'duplicate'
36	
37	  const bodyCode = hasBody && bodyText.length > NOTE_BODY_MAX_LENGTH ? 'body-too-long' : null
38	
39	  if (titleCode || bodyCode) {
40	    if (form) {
41	      if (hasBody) {
42	        const query = new URLSearchParams()
43	        if (titleCode) query.set('titleError', titleCode)
44	        if (bodyCode) query.set('bodyError', bodyCode)
45	        query.set('title', rawTitle)
46	        query.set('body', rawBody)
47	        return sendRedirect(event, `/notes/${existing.number}?${query.toString()}`, 303)
48	      }
49	      return fail(titleCode ?? 'invalid')
50	    }
51	    const statusMessage = titleCode === 'invalid'
52	      ? `Note must be 1-${NOTE_MAX_LENGTH} characters`
53	      : titleCode === 'too-long'
54	        ? `Use at most ${NOTE_MAX_LENGTH} characters`
55	        : titleCode === 'duplicate'
56	          ? 'You already have a note with this title'
57	          : `Use at most ${NOTE_BODY_MAX_LENGTH} characters in the body`
58	    const statusCode = titleCode === 'duplicate' ? 409 : 400
59	    throw createError({
60	      statusCode,
61	      statusMessage,
62	      data: hasBody ? { titleCode, bodyCode } : { code: titleCode },
63	    })
64	  }
65	
66	  const note = renameNote(name, id, title, hasBody ? bodyText : undefined)
67	  if (form) return sendRedirect(event, hasBody ? `/notes/${existing.number}?saved=1` : '/notes', 303)

<script setup lang="ts">
import { READ_ONLY_ERROR, type Note, type NotesResponse } from '#shared/types/note'

const route = useRoute()
const router = useRouter()

const { data, refresh } = await useFetch<NotesResponse>('/api/notes/archived', {
  key: 'archived-notes',
  default: () => ({ name: null, notes: [] }),
})

if (!data.value.name) {
  await navigateTo('/login', { replace: true })
}

const notes = computed(() => data.value.notes)
const restoring = ref<string | null>(null)

const errorCode = ref(String(route.query.error ?? ''))
const errorMessage = computed(() => (errorCode.value === 'read-only' ? READ_ONLY_ERROR : ''))

function clearErrorQuery() {
  if (route.query.error) router.replace({ query: {} })
}

async function restoreNote(note: Note) {
  if (restoring.value) return
  restoring.value = note.id
  try {
    await $fetch(`/api/notes/${note.id}/restore`, { method: 'POST', body: {} })
    errorCode.value = ''
    clearErrorQuery()
  } catch (error) {
    const { statusCode: status } = error as { statusCode?: number }
    if (status === 401) return navigateTo('/login')
    if (status === 403) errorCode.value = 'read-only'
  } finally {
    restoring.value = null
  }
  await refresh()
}

useHead({ title: 'Archive' })
</script>
